Analyze current implementation, docs, ULW evidence, tests, release posture, and remaining work. Deliver an evidence-backed code review, progress assessment, deficiency analysis, and ordered remaining-step plan. Tier: HEAVY because the user requested 전체 code review/progress analysis across architecture, security, QA, release readiness, and prior ULW evidence. Success criteria: C001 code review evidence from repository files and fresh static/test commands; C002 progress/readiness assessment from docs, plans, ULW ledgers, git history, and release gates; C003 ordered remaining-stage plan with blockers, owners, validation evidence, and no unsupported Windows/WinUI GA claim.

successCriteria.scenario: Code review proof: inspect Rust/JS/SQLite/GUI/media/report surfaces and run cargo fmt check, cargo clippy, cargo test, node syntax check, git diff check, and targeted repository scans; PASS only if findings are recorded with exact file references and command results.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/frame-review-progress-20260624/evidence/code-review-scan.md

successCriteria.scenario: Progress/readiness proof: inspect docs, plans, prior ULW ledgers, git history, release gates, Windows prerequisite outputs, GUI/data/query/media/report state; PASS only if completed vs partial vs blocked work is separated and unsupported Windows/WinUI GA claims are rejected.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/frame-review-progress-20260624/evidence/progress-readiness-audit.md

successCriteria.scenario: Remaining-step proof: synthesize an ordered, executable next-stage sequence with owners, blockers, validation commands, evidence artifacts, release gates, and explicit Windows/WinUI native validation as a separate prerequisite before production-ready claims.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/frame-review-progress-20260624/evidence/remaining-steps.md
